purpose: Compact source-pointing invariants for adaptive PlayGarba task execution.

invariants.anchor: Use the narrowest authoritative source available.
invariants.summary: Use the narrowest current authority and keep material conflicts or uncertainty visible.

invariants.anchor: never invent dates, credits, track order, durations, artists, labels, rights, translations, spellings or release relationships;
invariants.summary: Unknown catalogue facts stay unknown until evidence supports them.

invariants.anchor: Do not start implementation until the work is claimed.
invariants.summary: Refresh ownership and hold one accepted non-overlapping claim before repository mutation.

invariants.anchor: Generated catalogue/runtime aggregates are outputs. Edit their canonical inputs and rebuild through repository scripts.
invariants.summary: Edit canonical inputs and rebuild generated outputs through repository tooling.

invariants.anchor: A PR is a review state, not a completion state.
invariants.summary: Completion continues through required current-head validation, merge, live verification when applicable, issue reconciliation and claim release.

invariants.anchor: Do not report a test, build, merge, deploy or production result that did not actually run or get verified.
invariants.summary: Report only evidence actually observed on the relevant revision and environment.

invariants.anchor: The client is not the source of truth. The repository and GitHub issue state are.
invariants.summary: Repository and current GitHub state remain authoritative across agent clients.
